name: deepseekv41_mono_k1_x_post_comb_pre_hidden_size5120_q_rank1280_q_dim16384
description: The attention front of a DeepSeek-V4.1 layer on one rank, as one launch (the K1 of sglang's AMD monokernel, on this rank's query heads): the mHC boundary into the attention, the input RMSNorm, wqkv_a, the query through q_norm, wq_b and RoPE, and the token's KV record. residual_out[j] = x * post_mix[j] + sum_i comb_mix[i, j] * residual[i], rounded to bf16; the layer input is sum_j mix[j] * residual_out[j] under the previous boundary's pre mix, rounded to bf16, then times rsqrt(mean square + norm_eps) and norm_weight. This boundary's mixes come of the 24 logits hc_fn @ flatten(residual_out) * rsqrt(mean square + hc_rms_eps): sigmoid(logits[:4] * hc_scale[0] + hc_base[:4]) + hc_eps the pre mix, twice the sigmoid of the next 4 at hc_scale[1] the post mix, and the last 16 at hc_scale[2] as a 4 x 4 softmax over its rows plus hc_eps, normalized over columns, then sinkhorn_iters - 1 times over rows and columns (each sum plus hc_eps), the combination mix. Without x no post is owed; without prev_pre_mix (the first layer) the layer input is stream 0. The normed input, rounded to bf16 then to fp8 e4m3 at an e8m0 scale per 32 values (2**ceil(log2(amax / 448))), times wqkv is the qkv latent, rounded to bf16: q_rank columns of q's latent, then 512 of the KV latent. q's latent under its RMSNorm is q_latent; quantized the same way and times wq_b it is q, rounded to bf16, the last 64 values of every head then rotated in pairs (a, b) by the pair's (c, s) at the token's position: (a c - b s, a s + b c). The KV latent under its RMSNorm, its last 64 values rotated alike, is the record: k_rope those 64, and k_nope the first 448 as fp8 e4m3 at a scale per 64 values, 2**ceil(log2(max(amax, 1e-4) / 448)), whose e8m0 bytes are k_nope_scale.

mix_dim.description: The four streams flattened: the mix projection's reduction.

hidden_blocks.description: MXFP8 blocks of a hidden row.

q_dim.description: Every head on this rank's query, flattened.

qkv_dim.description: A qkv latent row: q's latent, then the KV latent.

q_rank_blocks.description: MXFP8 blocks of a q latent row.

x.description: The previous layer's FFN output, whose post is owed.

post_mix.description: The owed post's mix of x into each stream.

comb_mix.description: The owed post's mix of the streams: [token, from, to].

hc_fn.description: Projects the flattened streams to the 24 mix logits: 4 pre, 4 post, 16 combination.

hc_scale.description: Scale of the pre, post and combination logits.

norm_weight.description: Weight of the RMSNorm of the mixed streams.

hc_rms_eps.description: Added to the mean square of the streams.

hc_eps.description: Added to each pre mix and in each Sinkhorn normalization.

norm_eps.description: Added to each RMSNorm's mean square.

sinkhorn_iters.description: Sinkhorn normalizations of the combination mix.

wq_b.description: wq_b's weight: a head's 512 rows after another's.

rope_freqs.description: The RoPE table: a (c, s) per pair of each position.

positions.description: Each token's row of the RoPE table.

q.description: Each token's query per head, the RoPE part rotated.

residual_out.description: The streams after the owed post; the streams as given when none is owed.

pre_mix_out.description: This boundary's pre mix, which the next boundary sums the streams under.

post_mix_out.description: This boundary's post mix, of the post it owes.

comb_mix_out.description: This boundary's combination mix, of the post it owes.

normed.description: The layer input under its RMSNorm: the compressor's and indexer's input.

q_latent.description: q's latent under q_norm: the indexer's input.

k_nope.description: The record's position-free part, in units of its scales.

k_nope_scale.description: E8M0 exponent bytes at [token, block of 64]; a scale is 2**(byte - 127).
